post.text: The fireworks woke my baby up. It would be nice if they could end a little earlier...

history: みどり: Will the Bon dance go ahead even if it rains?
たけし: Last night so many cars were parked on the road behind the shrine that I couldn't get my car out of my house. Please do something about it.
ゆい: Will the yakisoba stall be there again this year? It was delicious last year, so I'm looking forward to it!
けんじ: I lost a blue children's water bottle. I think it was near the main tent.
さくら: An elderly man has collapsed next to the tower stage! Please call the first-aid staff!
まさる: The goldfish scooping seems more expensive than last year. I'd like an explanation of why.
あおい: What time do volunteers need to gather?
こうた: Where can I see the timetable for the extra buses?
ひろみ: I found a wallet on the ground, so I dropped it off at the main tent.
りょう: The trash bins are overflowing and litter is scattered on the street.
なつみ: It was fun again this year! Thank you to everyone who ran it.
しんじ: Excuse me, but could you kindly tell me where the smoking area is in the venue?
えり: I waited 30 minutes in line for takoyaki and it sold out right in front of me. What a fantastic festival.
だいき: The rotary in front of the station is jammed with pick-up cars and nothing is moving.
みか: My daughter is lost. She's a 5-year-old girl in a red yukata. If you see her, please contact the main tent!
ゆうすけ: My child who ate shaved ice says they feel a bit sick. Is there somewhere to rest?
あや: I dropped my phone. It has a black case with a cat sticker on the back.
のぶお: Can we apply to run a stall through this board again next year?
かおり: There are far too few toilets. It's really hard for people with kids.
たくや: The fireworks were amazing! I'll definitely come again next year.
まゆみ: Sorry for the trouble, but I would be grateful if you could guide me to a route passable by wheelchair.
けいた: One of the lantern decorations is about to fall and might hit people walking underneath.
ちひろ: I found a key with a bear keychain. Where should I take it?
ひでき: Earn 300,000 yen a month with a side job! Details at the link in my profile.
あきこ: As a neighbor, it would help if the music stage volume could be turned down a little.
そうた: Where's the bicycle parking?
れいこ: The man at the cotton candy stall was really kind. Thank you.
じゅん: I cut my foot and the bleeding won't stop. Do you at least have a bandage?
ともこ: I'd like to volunteer. Is it still possible to join?
まこと: I wrote the same thing last year, but once again there was no parking attendant this year.
ななみ: I just saw a pink hat in front of the main tent. I think someone lost it.
いさむ: Prices at every stall are tourist-trap prices. And this is supposed to be a local festival.
ゆか: Our cat got out. It's an orange tabby with a blue collar.
こうじ: Please tell me when the portable shrine will pass by.
みさき: Someone on a bench looks like they have heatstroke and is completely limp.
しょうへい: The trash sorting is confusing. Where should I throw away PET bottles?
えみ: I'm worried about tomorrow's weather. When will you decide if it's cancelled?
たつや: A drunk person is shouting on the street and the kids are scared.
さちこ: Are there any stalls that accept credit cards?
かずき: I wish the road closure had been announced earlier. I missed my bus.
りな: Is there anywhere that will help me put on a yukata?
ひろし: Classic organizers — every sign was pointing the wrong way.
あいこ: I lost my glasses. Black frames, no case.
ゆうた: There's an exposed cable behind the stage and someone tripped over it.
まり: Are there rules about taking photos? Can I post them on social media?
けん: Is there still space in the temporary parking lot?
ふみ: I look forward to it every year. Thank you in advance for this year too.
よしお: Exhaust from a stall's generator is blowing toward the seating area and it's smoky.
あすか: The lost boy found his mom. Thank you so much!
てつや: We apologize for troubling you when you are busy, but we kindly ask that you inform visitors to refrain from parking on the streets around the venue.
みずき: Isn't there a mask stall this year?
かつや: The shrine steps are dark and you can't see your feet.
ゆきこ: Someone left an umbrella behind. It's a clear plastic umbrella.
しゅん: Is it okay to come with a stroller? I'd like to know how crowded it is.
るみ: The grilled corn was undercooked. My child already ate it — will they be okay?
おさむ: Honestly, there were fewer stalls this year and it felt a little lonely.
ありさ: I lost my bicycle key. I can't get home and I'm stuck.
だいすけ: We're holding a used book fair in the neighborhood next month. Please come if you like!
はな: Can I join the Bon dance circle? Is it okay if I don't know the steps?

isComplaint.instructions: Is `post.text` a complaint about the organizers?

criteria.true: The writer describes a problem, dissatisfaction, or a request for improvement. Includes indirect wording
criteria.false: A question, thanks, a report, or anything else that is not a complaint
